correctness.rationale: Rank-three FO types are exactly obtained by the recursive SET of all one-vertex atomic extensions, including repeated vertices, so a three-round EF game is equivalent to the ordered triple profile. P_m for m>=7 has identical rank-three types by endpoint-distance and third-vertex neighborhood patterns; coordinatewise Duplicator strategy preserves king graph strong-product adjacency (both equal-or-adjacent components except equal full vertex). This reduces all infinite pairs to 28 unordered pairs 1<=m<=n<=7. Independently reimplemented full atomic diagram recursion on canonical graphs, obtaining precisely 22 classes and the stated nontrivial mergers, plus checked six larger representatives; independent ranking of class minimum products gives max 30. Thus the infinite quantifier follows from finite reduction, NOT empirical large-board checks. Statements exclude counting quantifiers and named coordinates.
